what_works: High contrast dark background with bright accent colors (orange, green) effectively highlights CTAs and key metrics.
Rounded 3px card components create visual hierarchy and a clean, organized layout.
Consistent spacing and sans-serif typography improve readability and visual balance across sections.
Clear visual distinction for interactive elements (buttons, tabs) using color and hover states guides user actions.
Two-column layout with distinct sections maintains visual balance while separating information.
